method: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Cut the baby potatoes into even pieces, toss with the measured oil and get them roasting first for 15 minutes so they actually have time to colour.
While they start, prepare the vegetables and chicken breast. Get the pan properly hot first. Cook the chicken breast until browned and cooked through — colour is flavour, so do not crowd the pan.

Add the vegetables to the hot tray and roast for another 15–20 minutes. Stir the measured sauce through near the end rather than drowning everything at the start; you want roasted edges, not steamed dinner.
Check the chicken breast is properly cooked and the potatoes are golden and tender. Let the tray sit for 2 minutes, taste, season if it needs it, then serve.

notes: Cooked browned chicken pieces, golden baby-potato pieces and roasted broccoli/red pepper have roasted edges and a light curry coating; no added garnish.
